summary: Dependency-confusion PoC exfiltrates host recon at postinstall
details: electrode-ota-ui-app@99.0.0 is a dependency-confusion takeover package targeting the 'electrode-ota-ui-app' name at an inflated version to shadow an internal package. package.json declares a postinstall hook that runs index.js, which collects host identifiers (os.hostname, os.userInfo, os.platform, os.release), fetches the installer's public IP from api.ipify.org and geolocation/ISP data from ipapi.co, and POSTs a JSON payload to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator callback URL. The final POST target is left as an unfilled placeholder in this build so the callback would fail, but the ipify/ipapi reconnaissance calls still fire on npm install, and the code shape is a working supply-chain exfiltration payload one string edit away from being live.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
